product_metadata.title: Ameriwood Home Englewood TV Stand for TVs up to 55", Espresso
features: Give your space a modern face-lift with the Ameriwood Home Englewood TY Stand up to 55"
TV Stand accommodates 55” flat panel TVs with a maximum weight of 65 lbs., Assembled dimensions: 22 15/16”h x 53 5/8”w x 16 9/16”d
Englewood consists of both open and closed storage with 3 adjustable shelves for your entertainment components, wire management holes help to keep your cords tidy and tangle free
Two glass doors, keeping your items safe from dust and dirt
Espresso finish looks great with any color scheme or décor
description: Elevate the look of your living room or home theater with the Ameriwood Home Englewood TV Stand for TVs up to 55". This espresso TV Stand displays your entertainment components in a simple, yet modern way. Behind the 2 glass doors are 2 shelves to keep DVDs, games, gaming systems, and other essentials safe from dust. Use the 2 open center shelves to keep your entertainment components you use the most like your Cable box, speakers or DVD player so you have easy access to them. The Englewood’s decorative slanted base design gives this TV stand a modern transitional stylish look. This TV Stand can accommodate flat panel TVs up to 55” wide. Ameriwood Home Englewood TV Stand requires assembly upon delivery. Assembled dimensions: 22.9375"H x 53.625"W x 16.5625"D. Care Instructions : Dust and wipe with a dry cloth and if needed, a damp cloth may be used sparingly
